title: Debug Stick Craft
description: Allow you to craft a debug stick
body:
Bring creative facility to your survival world ! Players can now craft vanille debug stick !

![Debug Stick Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/154dfa5de37f06ed3bc71d4a11ad23745ff2c941.png)

What makes it special:
- No mod loader needed
- Easy to craft
- Simple DataPack available for all minecraft version from 26.1 to 26.1.2

Perfect for:
- Survival servers/world wanting enhanced experience
- Redstone builds
